steps: Start at /us/ and navigate to Experience.
Confirm Cleveland is the closest observed Topgolf to downtown Toronto.
Choose Saturday, September 5, 2026 at 2:00 PM for four players and one bay.
Compare durations, confirm 60 minutes is unavailable, and select the longest available 120-minute session.
Enter guest details, acknowledge terms and cancellation policy, and review an $88.00 USD local-sandbox total.
Submit the sandbox-approved scenario and verify confirmation persists after refresh.
Inspect newest reservation and ownership boundary.
Reschedule or cancel and verify persistence.
Submit the declined or retryable sandbox outcome.
Remain on review with an actionable error.
Return to the server-owned review after a failed outcome.
